WFDB epicmp-compatible AF episode comparison

wfdb_epicmp_af.Rd

Reproduces the AF episode-by-episode and duration statistics of the WFDB program epicmp (version 10.7.0) for the conventions listed below, so that results can be checked against the reference implementation. This is a compatibility mode for a verified subset of epicmp behaviour, not a claim of compliance with ANSI/AAMI EC38 or EC57. Agreement with the executable was tested on the records described in the package's verification report.

Usage

wfdb_epicmp_af(ref, test, n_samples, fs, start_time = 300 * fs,
  end_time = NULL, min_length = 0, exclude_short_all = FALSE,
  exclude_afl = FALSE)

Arguments

ref,test

Annotation tables from read_wfdb_ann() (all annotations, not only rhythm, because the last annotation time matters).

n_samples

Record length in samples (0 or NA when undefined).

fs

Sampling frequency (used for the default start_time).

start_time,end_time

Comparison period in samples. `end_time = NULL` uses the record length.

min_length

Minimum episode length in samples.

exclude_short_all

Apply min_length to both annotators (-I).

exclude_afl

Exclude reference AFL from the +P pass (-x).

Details

Conventions reproduced (all times in samples):

  • AF episodes begin at a rhythm annotation whose label starts with "(AFIB" and end at the next rhythm annotation with any other label. Atrial flutter ("(AFL") therefore ends an AF episode.

  • An episode still open at the end of the file ends at the later of the comparison end time and the last annotation read from that file (of any type).

  • The comparison starts at start_time (default 5 minutes, the epicmp learning period); episodes of the annotator being scored are clipped to \[start_time, end_time\] and the other annotator's episodes are not clipped.

  • The default end is the record length; when the record length is zero or unknown, epicmp uses end_time = -1, which selects no episodes. This is reproduced.

  • Any positive overlap makes a match; one test episode can match several reference episodes and vice versa. Episodes shorter than min_length are ignored for the scored annotator (-i); exclude_short_all applies the -I behaviour to the other annotator as well.

  • exclude_afl = TRUE excludes reference atrial flutter from the positive-predictivity pass (-x, EC38:1998 behaviour).

Value

A list with STP, FN, PTP, FP (episode counts), ref_overlap, ref_duration, test_overlap, test_duration (in samples) and the four percentages ESe, EPP, DSe, DPP rounded as epicmp prints them.

Examples

ref <- data.frame(sample = c(0, 100000, 200000), type = 28L,
                  aux = c("(N", "(AFIB", "(N"))
tst <- data.frame(sample = c(0, 120000, 260000), type = 28L,
                  aux = c("(N", "(AFIB", "(N"))
wfdb_epicmp_af(ref, tst, n_samples = 300000, fs = 250)
#> $STP
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $FN
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $PTP
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $FP
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $ref_overlap
#> [1] 80000
#> 
#> $ref_duration
#> [1] 1e+05
#> 
#> $test_overlap
#> [1] 80000
#> 
#> $test_duration
#> [1] 140000
#> 
#> $ESe
#> [1] 100
#> 
#> $EPP
#> [1] 100
#> 
#> $DSe
#> [1] 80
#>
